reviews.inviteTitle: Ask a regular client for a review
reviews.inviteHint: Record a visit that already happened and we send the client a personal link to rate the professional. No account needed.
reviews.inviteRules: One link works for one review of one visit. Visits from the last 90 days, one request per client and professional every 30 days. These reviews are labelled “visit confirmed by the salon”, and the salon cannot delete or hide them, negative ones included.
reviews.inviteNoTeam: Add a professional with services in the Team tab to ask for reviews.
reviews.invited: Request sent. The client got the link by e-mail.

inviteErrors.invalid: Check the name, e-mail and date (up to 90 days ago, not in the future).
inviteErrors.duplicate: You already asked this client to review this professional in the last 30 days.
inviteErrors.limit: You reached today's request limit. Try again tomorrow.

reviews.cannotDelete: Salons cannot delete reviews. You can reply publicly or report a fake review to moderation.

menu.hint: Organise the menu in sections. Changes show up right away on the public page and behind the table QR code.
menu.invalid: Check the name and the price (for example 12.50).
menu.empty: Start with a section such as “Starters”, then add dishes.

qr.hint: Print this card and put it on your tables. Guests scan it with their phone camera and the menu opens in their phone's language.
qr.notListed: The code already works, but guests can open the menu only once the restaurant is published (Profile tab).
qr.scan: Leia o código para ver o menu
